metadata.case_name: LEUNG HIU YAN HILDA v. LAU KAM HUNG

plaintiff.occupation_before: Senior research assistant of the Hong Kong Institute of Education (HKIE)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Primary school teacher (Po Leung Kuk school from 1 September 2010; later St Joseph's, teacher and panel head of music)

source: soft tissue injury of the neck and back
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain, stiffness or tenderness only

injuries.description: Low back sprain / soft tissue injury of lumbar region
source: soft tissue injury of the neck and back
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: Early degenerative change of a number of discs in the cervical and lumbar region
source: the MRI of Madam Leung's cervical spine and lumbar spine done after the subsequent road traffic accident showed early degenerative change of quite a number of discs in the cervical and lumbar region, apart from reduction of the cervical lordosis
the disc degeneration is related to the effect of ageing in the past 2 years and not due to trauma

manifestations.description: Tenderness over lower back (paraspinal muscles on both sides)
Limited range of movement mainly in extension (neck)
Range of movement slightly limited (low back)
Intermittent residual pain in the midline area of her neck and low back preventing her from lying on her back to sleep and disturbing her sleep
Unable to walk or stand for long time, or to squat
Could not enjoy playing badminton and has to reduce the time for playing piano and guzheng at home
No focal neurological deficit elicited / no neurological deficit in the upper or lower limbs

treatments_received: A&E attendance at Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital (AHNH)
Physiotherapy (attended UH physiotherapy on 15, 17 & 21 April 2010; physiotherapy at AHNH from 16 May to 1 August 2012)
X-ray (skull, lumbosacral spine and cervical spine unremarkable)
MRI scan of the cervical spine and lumbar spine

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Could not enjoy playing badminton and has to reduce the time for playing piano and guzheng at home
Unable to walk or stand for long time, or to squat

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy quiet or solitude
losses.description: Pain prevents her from lying on her back to sleep and such limit on her sleeping posture disturbs her sleep

comparable_cases.case_name: Lai Ka Yin v Chan Yiu Kei
comparable_cases.injury_description: Whiplash injuries to neck and back; soft tissue injury of the neck and back with no evidence of any more serious injury; able to return to pre-accident job; no fracture of the cervical spine

comparable_cases.case_name: Lo Yim Fong v Ho Po Yin & Anor
comparable_cases.injury_description: Soft tissue sprain of neck and back, without bony fracture or neurological deficit; plaintiff returned to work as a clerk after 10 days
